---
title: "Dictionary"
# Type view: every page whose `type` is `term`, alphabetical.
listing:
  id: dictionary
  contents:
    - "../topics/*.qmd"
    - "../topics/*.md"
    - "../dictionary/*.qmd"
    - "../dictionary/*.md"
    - "../essays/*.qmd"
    - "../essays/*.md"
    - "../prototypes/*.qmd"
    - "../prototypes/*.md"
    - "../tools/*.qmd"
    - "../tools/*.md"
  include:
    type: term
  type: table
  sort: title
  fields: [title, theme, maturity]
  field-display-names:
    theme: "Theme"
    maturity: "Maturity"
  sort-ui: false
---
